caption: The drawing features a large, closed book with a thick brown cover that appears to be leather, adorned with gold-toned decorative elements and metal corner pieces, as well as metal clasps on the front and side. The edges of the pages are a golden-yellow color, indicating gilding. The book cover includes an ornate, symmetrical embossed design with a central quatrefoil shape, and there are four visible round, silver-colored studs near the corners. Surrounding the main image of the book are multiple smaller, sketched elements: at the top right and bottom right, there are decorative corner designs; at the bottom center, a keyhole-like embellishment; at the bottom left, a horizontal floral border; at the top center, the word “Album” in a stylized script with a small sketched, standing book to the left of it. The overall composition is balanced, with the detailed, colored image of the book at the center and the additional pencil sketches framing it on a cream-colored background. The artist’s signature, “Manuel G. Batawa,” is present in the bottom left corner.
title: Photograph Album
